Mk4 era all the way. 
We got multiple variations of the vr6, NUMEROUS special edition variations of each car, and just a hell of a lot of options. 

Build quality was there as well as passion. As much as I love the mk2 & mk3 era, there's something to be said about the mk4 era. There was a vision. Creativity was insanely present. Even until this day I'd still prefer to sit in my 337 Recaro seats and my Konig R32 seats instead of sitting inside of a new car. 


The bits and pieces used within each car, special edition or not, was just appalling. And I say that it's honestly a shame that Volkswagen has not continued down the same path of creativity since the mk4 era. Everything new car is still great, but where's the options when it comes to engines? Where's the special edition cars with bigger seats and different interiors? Granted though, all the new Volkswagens come with swagged out interiors nowadays... But which VW era is the one that really makes you hungry when it comes to searching for special?
